glossary.def: A high-tier speed buff that triggers for same-row allies when the caster's speed is high enough.

Specialized Acceleration: sharply raises SPD; if the main target is slower, it deals bonus Extra DMG. At battle start it raises SPD by about 20 to 32 percent; if the main target's SPD is LOWER than the unit, it deals an extra 500 to 600 percent ATK as Extra DMG. Higher SPD means acting and ultimate-ing first — the backbone of speed teams.

Encourage: grants allies extra energy at the start of each round for a number of rounds. At the start of each round, allies gain an extra 2 (or 3) energy, lasting 3 to 5 rounds. It is the team's energy accelerator, enabling earlier Ultimates — the counterweight to energy-seal and drain effects.

Resurrection: after taking fatal damage, if an ally remains, the unit recovers some HP and keeps fighting. Triggers after a fatal hit: while an ally is on the field, it heals about 50 to 60 percent HP before the next action, limited in count. Some versions also absorb all damage types while waiting to heal. Blocked by anti-revive effects.

glossary.def: Hiệu ứng bất lợi làm tăng sát thương mà toàn bộ kẻ địch bị ảnh hưởng phải nhận. Các mức Tăng Sát Thương (DI) cùng loại CỘNG dồn vào hệ số tấn công (fight:sum_hurt), tổng kẹp tối đa ×4 — một trong bốn thừa số nhân độc lập của sát thương cuối.

Unyielding (Bất Khuất): không thể bị hạ xuống dưới 1 HP — sống sót qua đòn đáng lẽ chí mạng. Là một CỜ trên nhân vật (họ NotDeath), kiểm ngay khi máu chạm 0 — nó cho SỐNG chứ không thu nhỏ đòn. Vài trạng thái bất tử còn kèm 'bỏ qua sát thương' ghim đòn về 1.
Bỏ Qua Sát Thương: trạng thái phớt lờ sát thương nhận vào; bị [Evolve]/[Specialized Evolve] hủy. Vô hiệu sát thương nhận vào cho tới khi bị [Evolve]/[Specialized Evolve] gỡ.

Né Tránh Sát Thương Tức Thì: theo tỉ lệ, mỗi đòn Trực Tiếp, Phụ Trội, Tích Lũy và Cuồng Bạo chỉ gây 1 sát thương. Đây là chỗ có con số trần 80 phần trăm né. Xác suất né bằng tỉ lệ Né chia cho một cộng Chính Xác của địch, kẹp trần 80 phần trăm. Né thành công thì đòn bị ghim về 1, không phải về 0. Né và giảm-thương chia chung một ngân sách.

Bảo Hộ Chuyên Biệt: một lớp khiên lớn hấp thụ sát thương, tính theo phần trăm ATK hoặc Máu tối đa. Khiên này khử sát thương nhận vào và cộng dồn được với các hiệu ứng thêm Máu, nhưng tổng lượng sát thương hấp thụ bị giới hạn ở mức 15 lần Máu gốc của nhân vật. Nó bị bể trước máu thật và có thể được hồi lại bởi các kỹ năng liên quan.

Hộ Thể Chuyên Biệt: một lớp khiên khử sát thương, cộng dồn với hiệu ứng thêm Máu. Khiên tạo ra theo phần trăm ATK, khử sát thương nhận vào và cộng dồn được với hiệu ứng thêm Máu; tổng sát thương khử bị chặn ở mức 15 lần Máu gốc. Bị bể trước máu thật và có thể được hồi lại từ sát thương liên tục gây lên địch.

glossary.def: A debuff that increases the damage all affected enemies take. Same-type DMG-Increase (DI) rates ADD into the attacker's offensive factor (fight:sum_hurt) and the sum is capped at ×4 — one of the four independent multipliers of the final damage.
Evolve: on hit, immediately cancels the target's [Unyielding] and [Ignore DMG] statuses. On hit it strips the target's [Unyielding] and [Ignore DMG], opening it to damage.

Unyielding: cannot be reduced below 1 HP — survives an otherwise lethal hit. A FLAG on the unit (the NotDeath family) checked when HP would hit 0 — it lets you SURVIVE rather than shrinking the hit. Some undying states also carry an ignore-damage that pins the hit to 1.
Ignore DMG: a status that ignores incoming damage; cancelled by [Evolve]/[Specialized Evolve]. Nullifies incoming damage until stripped by [Evolve]/[Specialized Evolve].

Instant DMG Evasion: a chance for each Direct, Extra, Charge and Berserk hit to deal only 1 damage. This is where the 80 percent evade cap lives. Evade chance equals your Evasion divided by one plus the enemy's Accuracy, capped at 80 percent. On an evade the hit is pinned to 1, not zeroed. Evasion and mitigation share one budget.

Specialized Protection: a large shield that absorbs damage, scaled off ATK or Max HP. This shield removes incoming damage and stacks with extra-HP effects, but the total damage it can absorb is capped at 15 times the unit's original HP. It is eaten before real HP and can be refilled by related skills.

Specialized Guard: a shield layer that removes damage, stacking with extra-HP effects. The shield scales off ATK, removes incoming damage, and stacks with extra-HP effects; total damage removed is capped at 15 times original HP. It is eaten before real HP and can be replenished from DoT dealt to enemies.

glossary.def: Corrosion: a DoT scaled off ATK, placed on the target for a number of turns. It deals DoT equal to a percentage of ATK each turn (usually 8 to 20 percent), lasting 2 turns; it can be applied on a crit. Some units buff the team per enemy under Corrosion, or inflict [Weaken] on Corroded enemies.

Unyielding: cannot be reduced below 1 HP — survives an otherwise lethal hit. A FLAG on the unit (the NotDeath family) checked when HP would hit 0 — it lets you SURVIVE rather than shrinking the hit. Some undying states also carry an ignore-damage that pins the hit to 1.

Specialized Corrode: a spreading DoT, the Specialized (特化) variant of Corrode. Deals DoT scaled off ATK; after any character acts the effect transfers to a random enemy and disappears after 3 transfers. Some units cause a target under Specialized Corrode to become [Stuck] (follow-ups locked).
A control state that prevents the target from launching [Follow-up] and [Consecutive Follow-up], typically for 2 rounds.

Follow-up: an extra attack fired outside your turn when a condition is met (e.g. an ally attacks). Usually a repeat of a basic attack at some % of its damage and effects, capped to a number of triggers per turn.
Consecutive Follow-up: a chain of repeated follow-up strikes. A chain of repeated follow-up hits; disabled together with [Follow-up] by [Stuck].

Combo Follow-up: a follow-up fired after an ally acts, repeating the Ultimate and unaffected by Hit/Resist. After any ally acts, the unit (and sometimes the whole row) fires 100 percent of the Ultimate's damage and effect at random targets, usually unaffected by Hit/Resist, capped per round. Blocked by follow-up locks.

Ultimate Follow-up: an off-turn follow-up that repeats the Ultimate's damage and effect, at no energy cost. Deals about 70 to 100 percent of the Ultimate skill's damage AND effect, at no energy cost, capped at 2 to 3 times per round. Blocked by [Lock]/[Paralysis]/[Stuck] which lock follow-ups.

The team's battle status bar at the bottom of the combat screen (怒气). Fills during battle; 1000 Energy Gauge converts into 1 [Energy] point. Skills grant it or spend it (an ultimate may cost e.g. 900 on cast). Distinct from [Energy] points.

glossary.def: DMG Amplification: increases the damage the affected units deal by a percentage. Raises the affected unit's outgoing damage; can be applied to a row and dispel enemy buffs.

Weaken: a debuff that lowers the target's ATK for a number of turns. It directly lowers the target's ATK (about 10 to 50 percent) for 1 to 2 turns, weakening both its damage and its ATK-scaling effects. Some units apply a stronger Weaken to enemies already under [Corrosion].

A defensive buff that reduces incoming Charge-type damage by a set percentage each turn. Same-type DMG-Reduction (DIV) rates add in the DENOMINATOR (fight:sum_unhurt): incoming = damage / (1 + Σreductions), so stacking gives diminishing returns and the taken-multiplier is clamped to [0.1×, 2×].

Specialized Unyielding: the Specialized (特化) variant of Unyielding — when an ally would take fatal damage they enter a state that takes no damage and heals. When an ally takes fatal damage they enter this state, take no damage, and it disappears after a set number of characters act, restoring 100 percent Max HP. It replaces normal Unyielding and is NOT affected by ignore-Unyielding effects. Only [Breakthrough]/[Specialized Breakthrough] or a piercing hit can cancel it.

Unyielding: cannot be reduced below 1 HP — survives an otherwise lethal hit. A FLAG on the unit (the NotDeath family) checked when HP would hit 0 — it lets you SURVIVE rather than shrinking the hit. Some undying states also carry an ignore-damage that pins the hit to 1.

glossary.def: Berserk: a state that increases the damage you deal for a number of turns. While active, its bonus ADDS into your amplification sum — so it shares the +300% (×4) amplify ceiling.
Continuous Pursuit: a follow-up that chases additional low-HP enemies. A follow-up that keeps chasing extra targets, usually the lowest-HP enemies.

Charge DMG: a damage type that is stored up then released, and can ignore Tenacity shields. It accumulates into stacks (each scaled off ATK or the target's Max HP) then unleashes; its core strength is that it IGNORES Tenacity and Resilience shields. It is one of the four damage types that [Evasion] can pin to 1.
Immunity against Stun: makes the unit immune to [Stun]. Grants immunity to [Stun], often to a whole row or after a delay.
Immunity against Extra DMG: makes the unit immune to Extra DMG. Blocks Extra DMG entirely; some kits upgrade it from 1-round to permanent.
